site.name: Jimmy Kane

hero.intro: I build the Ford Credit mobile app, co-lead a 250-member graduate program, and spend my off hours teaching karate, mentoring a robotics team and working the Eagles gameday crew.

site.bioTeaser: PLACEHOLDER: Born and raised in Bensalem, PA, I'm trying to give back to the community that helped me grow up. By day I'm an iOS developer at Ford Credit; the rest of my time goes to youth, church and the community.
